responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping companion for the IQ2000 target option table. This file is generated from iq2000.opt and GCC’s rendered option documentation, and supplies UrlSuffix annotations for target-specific switches when matching manual anchors exist; in this instance it records that the IQ2000 -m options currently have no discovered documentation URLs, so the generated option-processing/docs machinery has no per-option manual link targets to attach for this backend.
